en.text: Harbor City and Ridgeway United traded blows in a tight match that ended 1-1. Lenny Voss scored first for Harbor City at the 2:00 mark, but Pieter Lund equalized for Ridgeway United just over two minutes later. Both teams had strong chances, with several shots saved by the goalkeepers throughout the game.

rejections: the score is level, no team leads

en.text: Harbor City and Ridgeway United finished level at 1-1 in a dead-even contest with identical possession (50%-50%) and shots on target (2-2). Lenny Voss opened the scoring for Harbor City from 23 m at 93 km/h, but Pieter Lund equalized for Ridgeway United shortly after. Both sides created chances early, including a high-speed shot by Idris Okafor saved by Marco Azevedo and a blocked strike by Hugo Lindqvist.
rejections: the score is level, no team leads
